summary: Independent verification of Aurem/ORA bugs A-E (chat_sessions persistence, Review-findings navigation, chat scan-followup wiring, advisor findings counter, scan summary category count). 9 backend regression tests written (test_aurem_bugs_a_e_2026_01.py) — all 9 PASS against live preview backend + real project p_64987820ec. Frontend Bug B verified live in browser: /codebase-health?project_id=p_64987820ec loads real data (109 issues, code_quality + database breakdown) WITHOUT redirecting to /dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug A fix (routers/codebase_health.py L423): correct — direct $push into db.chat_sessions.turns with upsert:true, same shape as _persist_turn, so GET /chat/history durably returns it on reload.
Bug D fix (routers/codebase_health.py L245): persist_findings_to_backlog is invoked BEFORE the JSONResponse return; wrapped in try/except so a mongo hiccup can't fail the scan.

Bug E fix (routers/codebase_health.py L352): `for cat in categories` iterates the request's requested categories (not `breakdown.keys()` which would drop 0-finding cats). Header and body now provably match.
Bug C wiring (routers/chat/worker.py L1281 vs L1286): _scan_followup_check dispatched BEFORE _mode_broadcast inside run_worker — early exit works before mode classifier can mis-route.

Bug B (frontend/src/pages/CodebaseHealth.jsx): reads project_id via useSearchParams, gate removed — verified live in browser: /codebase-health?project_id=p_64987820ec renders real breakdown (109 code_quality issues, 0 database) as non-founder-scoped user, no /dashboard redirect.

Minor: the /scan endpoint's chat-persist block does `time.time()` for ts and manually writes updated_at/last_message/turns — duplicates _persist_turn logic. Consider extracting to a shared helper to keep future writers in sync.

Minor: has_scan_followup_signal is purely regex-based (_SCAN_REFERENCE_RX). Semantic false positives possible for messages like 'scan through the code and tell me...'. Acceptable given the recency+existence gate in _recent_project_scan short-circuits when there's no fresh scan.
seed_data_creation: Each test session_id uses fresh uuid (TEST_sess_<hex>) to avoid cross-test contamination; chat_sessions upserts create fresh docs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests from /app/backend with env: `cd /app/backend && export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env|cut -d= -f2) && export $(grep -E '^(MONGO_URL|DB_NAME)=' .env|sed 's/"//g'|xargs) && python -m pytest tests/test_aurem_bugs_a_e_2026_01.py -v`. Bug C fix-action path (real GitHub PR creation) was deliberately NOT invoked to avoid PR spam; main agent already independently proved it with real commit shas c73c89f/4eb440f and open PRs #3/#4 on polarisbuiltinc-wq/Aurem-1.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — verification pass only. All 5 fixes hold under regression tests.
